required.text: specs/sdk.md explicitly states that a killed preparation process can leave build/.prepare-lock, requiring inspection for an active process before manual removal. This is deliberate portable fail-closed behavior; automatic PID-based stale-lock deletion is not part of the contract. Normal exceptions and KeyboardInterrupt run cleanup and independently release the lock. Incomplete installation rollback preserves original backups in a diagnostic recovery directory and must never remove them. SIGKILL cannot run finally handlers; a retained lock after process death is documented manual recovery, not a promise of automatic restart. Review actual data loss, incorrect backup/lock behavior or unsupported cleanup assumptions; do not treat absence of automatic stale-lock deletion as a correctness failure of this explicitly scoped local SDK. No severity overrides or baseline suppressions apply.
